Chair 4, "state legislatures with court oversight to prevent extreme partisan bias", is further off: proposed Article XXI, section 2(B) makes the Commission "the EXCLUSIVE MEANS to adopt any plan to alter legislative districts or congressional districts", which removes the General Assembly from map-drawing rather than preserving it. ⚠ The eleven rows at chair 4 did not describe a chair at all — they recorded a motive ("a Republican-led redistricting reform effort opposing Democratic-drawn maps"), and a motive is not a position on a ladder.
